sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] TRF-043-ShipShape > sh:property[nltl:hasComponent]: The unqualified sh:class nltl:frame and sh:node FrameShape constraints apply to every value of the generic hasComponent path, so unrelated ship components are incorrectly required to be frames and satisfy the framing-ice-strengthening constraints. Required change: Constrain only hasComponent values that are nltl:frame instances, using a qualified value shape or an equivalent frame-selective path while preserving validation of each applicable frame.

rows: [FORMULA_TABLE] TRF-043-FrameShape below-LIWL SPARQL constraint: The IA Super bow row is implemented as a numeric minimum of 2.0 m, but Table 4-6 requires the framing to extend down to the tank top or below the top of floors; the declared reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop evidence is never used. Required change: Replace the IA Super bow numeric 2.0 m branch with enforcement that reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop is true, while retaining 2.0 m only for the IA Super midbody branch and the stated numeric minima for the other rows. | [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] TRF-043-FrameShape iceClass and hullRegion table constraints: The shape permits iceClass II, iceClass III, and otherIceStrengthenedAreaValue, but the Table 4-6 checks do not define corresponding rows: the below-LIWL check incorrectly applies non-IA-Super thresholds to II and III, while the above-LIWL check and all checks for the other region are absent. Required change: Restrict this table-driven rule to the explicitly covered classes and regions, or add an explicit applicability model; do not use iceClass != iceClassIaSuper as a substitute for the IA, IB, and IC table rows.

[UNIT_CONVERSION] TerminationCaseShape.extensionBeyondAdjacentDeckOrTankBoundary and FrameShape framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline/framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline: The candidate binds quantity units to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/MilliM and http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/M, but the canonical QUDT unit IRIs are http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M. Canonical quantity values therefore fail the unit constraints, and the SPARQL table and threshold checks use the wrong unit IRIs. Required change: Declare a QUDT unit prefix for http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and replace qudt:MilliM and qudt:M in sh:hasValue constraints and SPARQL unit comparisons with the corresponding vocabulary-unit IRIs.

[WRONG_TARGET] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-FrameShape: The requirement target owner is ship, but this shape targets nltl:frame directly and provides no ship-to-frame path. It therefore validates unrelated frame instances rather than applying the framing obligations through the required ship ownership context. Required change: Target the required ship owner and add the canonical path to the applicable frame instances, or otherwise establish the required ship-owned frame scope. | [DATATYPE] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-TerminationCaseShape / nltl:iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted: The candidate uses this required comparison/output term in SPARQL but never constrains its values to xsd:boolean. A non-boolean value can coexist with a boolean true value and still satisfy the NOT EXISTS test, allowing malformed evidence to pass. Required change: Constrain nltl:iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted to xsd:boolean on the termination-case node, with the required value semantics. | [CARDINALITY] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-TerminationCaseShape / nltl:iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted: The candidate has no cardinality constraint for the boolean termination-permission result. Multiple values, including conflicting true and false values, can be present; the SPARQL check passes if any true value exists, leaving the result semantically ambiguous. Required change: Require the modeled boolean result with minCount 1 and maxCount 1, unless the authoritative model explicitly permits a multi-valued result. | [DATATYPE] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-TerminationCaseShape / nltl:extensionBeyondAdjacentDeckOrTankBoundary: The quantity node is constrained only by numericValue and unit properties and is not constrained as a QUDT QuantityValue, despite the canonical property range being qudt:QuantityValue. An arbitrary resource carrying those predicates can therefore be accepted as the measurement. Required change: Require the value of nltl:extensionBeyondAdjacentDeckOrTankBoundary to be a qudt:QuantityValue while retaining the decimal numeric value and unit:MilliM constraints. | [DATATYPE] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-FrameShape / nltl:framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline: The quantity node is not constrained as a QUDT QuantityValue even though the canonical property range is qudt:QuantityValue, so an arbitrary resource with matching numericValue and unit predicates can satisfy the table check. Required change: Require the quantity value to be a qudt:QuantityValue in addition to the existing decimal numericValue and metre-unit constraints. | [DATATYPE] urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-043-FrameShape / nltl:framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline: The quantity node is not constrained as a QUDT QuantityValue even though the canonical property range is qudt:QuantityValue, so an arbitrary resource with matching numericValue and unit predicates can satisfy the table check. Required change: Require the quantity value to be a qudt:QuantityValue in addition to the existing decimal numericValue and metre-unit constraints.

[WRONG_APPLICABILITY] TRF-043-ShipShape > sh:property[nltl:hasComponent]: The unqualified sh:class nltl:frame and sh:node FrameShape constraints apply to every value of the generic hasComponent path, so unrelated ship components are incorrectly required to be frames and satisfy the framing-ice-strengthening constraints. Required change: Constrain only hasComponent values that are nltl:frame instances, using a qualified value shape or an equivalent frame-selective path while preserving validation of each applicable frame.
